name: Cords Cable Industries Limited
about: Cords Cable Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of control and instrumentation cables in India. The company offers control and electrical wiring cables; power cables; instrumentation, signal, and data cables; thermocouple cables; and fieldbus, fire survival, EPR, silicone, xtreme temp, flexible, low tox, tox free, oil resist, super oil resist, railway jelly filled quad, and eurabalise railway safety cables. It also provides extension/compensating and communication cables; and customized cable solutions. The company sells its products under the CORDS brand. It serves power, oil and gas, refineries, petrochemicals, steel, cement, chemicals, water and desalination, metro rail, airports, renewable energy, and other infrastructure-related applications. The company also exports its products. Cords Cable Industries Limited was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
